item.title: Home
item.description: David Islip is a quantitative researcher and Ph.D. graduate from the University of Toronto, specializing in financial optimization, machine learning, and operations research. Currently at Balyasny Asset Management.

item.title: Some Facts about Bootstrapping
item.description: Asymptotic results on bootstrapping: the mean absolute deviation of normal variables, quantile of absolute deviations from the mean, and the distribution of standard deviations.

item.title: Presentations
item.description: Conference presentations and talks by David Islip on stochastic programming, portfolio optimization, and machine learning in finance.

item.title: Probability of Constraint Satisfaction and Robust Optimization
item.description: An overview of the connection between probability of constraint satisfaction and robust optimization, with applications to chance-constrained programming.

item.title: Research
item.description: Published and working papers by David Islip on financial optimization, support vector machines, stochastic programming, and machine learning for portfolio management.
